notes.title: ECHOPLEX exits Early Access today!
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce that ECHOPLEX is now available as a full release on Steam.

Here's what's new:

[list]
[*]Explore 18 challenging new levels.
[*]Collect fragments throughout each level that combine to form a new video memory when you solve the puzzle.
[*]Freeze time to explore puzzles.
[*]Face armed autonomous drones and use them to destroy your Echoes.
[*]Test your skill against timed static pulses in new platforming elements.
[*]Rewatch pieces of the story you have collected in new video review UI.
[*]Experience 4 new story chapters – completing the FMV story!
[/list]

Check out the launch trailer below:

https://youtu.be/OVyFoUe4oK4

Once again, thank you to every player who gave us feedback during Early Access - your comments, emails and reviews helped make this release what it is.

If you're a reviewer and want more info, [url=http://echoplexgame.com/presskit/] there is a presskit here [/url] .

-- Tyron van Vuuren
ECHOPLEX Game Director

notes.title: Achievements and Time Trials are live!
notes.content:
Where will you rank? :D

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/achievement-announcement-header_web.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce Update 0.3.0, which includes 3 big changes: 

[h1]1. Time Trials[/h1]

We’ve had many requests for a time trial feature to be added, so here it is!

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/time-trial-designs.jpg[/img]

The time trial feature will unlock after you've successfully completed all 15 levels of the Early Access edition.

Your score is the total amount of time spent playing through all 15 levels (including any deaths or restarts), and your ranking will be displayed on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/611060/leaderboards/1989724/]Global Leaderboard[/url].

[h1]2. Better climbing controls[/h1]

We’ve adjusted the climbing physics and animation to give you more control at the top of the climb (rather than getting automatically pushed forward).  Transitioning from climbing to moving is now much more fluid.

(The change in player control has caused small animation problems for the Echo climbing - but they are next on the list.)

[h1]3. Achievements[/h1]

There are 3 types of achievements:

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/levelav.png[/img]

[b]Level Achievements:[/b] These are earned after each level that you complete.

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/perfectrun.png[/img]

[b]Perfect Run Achievements:[/b] These are earned for a completing a series of levels without having to restart the level (due to dying, time expiring, or giving up).

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/timetrialav.png[/img]

[b]Time Trial Achievements:[/b] These are earned for completing levels within the allotted time.

The achievements TO BE CONTINUED and BENDING TIME are exclusive to Early Access.

[h1]Also in this update:[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]A smexy new menu! (see below)[/*]
[*]Extension of the first two levels![/*]
 	[*]Exciting bug fixes![/*]
[/list]

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/new-menu.jpg[/img]

As always, let us know if you have any feedback in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/611060/discussions/]Discussions[/url] or mail the game director directly: tyron@outputgames.com

Happy time trialling!

[b]Output Games - Making the Simulation a Better Place[/b]

notes.title: The Compass Update (0.2.9)
notes.content:
[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/compass-update-header.jpg[/img]

The Compass Update introduces two new features:

1. [b]The Compass[/b] - Shows you the position of the memory fragment in each level, and the color of the room it’s located in.  The compass also shows the position of your Echoes.

2. [b]Static Floors[/b] - These floors kill you on contact, so you’ll now die if you fall into any of those deep drops between platforms (rather than just hanging out down there).

Also in this update:

[list]
[*]Added an option to turn anti-aliasing on and off
[*]Fixed a bug that caused you to fall through the floor when exiting Premonition
[*]Updated the video player that handles cut scenes
[/list]

As always, let us know if you have any issues in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/611060/discussions/]Discussions[/url].

notes.content:
- [b]Fixed anti-aliasing[/b] - Edges should now be smooth

- [b]Added an alert for missing video codec causing a black screen at game start[/b] - In order to play the FMV cut-scenes, ECHOPLEX requires an .H264 video codec that is not included on some Windows editions. The alert provides a free download link from the Microsoft website.

notes.title: [VIDEO] The Premonition Update is live
notes.content:
[img]http://echoplexgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Premonition.jpg[/img]

[i]**Please note: The Premonition Update makes fundamental changes to the way ECHOPLEX works, so any existing game progress will be lost.  We’re working hard to improve the gameplay experience based on your feedback - and this type of update is a reality of Early Access development.  Thank you for hanging in there while we make the game better!**[/i]

The first major update to ECHOPLEX is live... And it's a game changer.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/611060/ECHOPLEX/]The Premonition Update[/url] (previously known as the Timeline Update) introduces two new features to ECHOPLEX Early Access: [b]Premonition[/b] and [b]Timelines[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A76CuQD1hyU

[h1]Premonition allows you to freeze time[/h1]

When we first launched [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/611060/ECHOPLEX/]ECHOPLEX Early Access[/url], many players requested a way to explore the puzzles and the environment without the pressure of the Echo following.

This is where [b]Premonition[/b] comes in. When you activate Premonition, time freezes. This allows you to explore the environment, moving through any area that is already unlocked, while your Echo (or Echoes) stay frozen in place. When you exit Premonition, time unfreezes and the chase is on again. You can enter and exit Premonition by pressing TAB, and there are no limits to using it.

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/premonition-update-2.jpg[/img] [i]"Premonition" allows you to freeze time so you can explore the puzzles without the Echo following you[/i]

[h1]Timelines make the game more strategic[/h1]

The second new feature introduced in the Premonition update is [b]Timelines[/b]. When we first released ECHOPLEX Early Access, some players told us that they were completing levels by simply running blindly until they unlocked the puzzles by luck. We’ve spent a lot of time designing the puzzles, and we want to make sure you get a sense of accomplishment when you solve them.

So in this update, we’ve added a time limit to each level and a lifespan to each Echo. These time limits are customized specifically to each puzzle - so you’ll really have to think about how to complete the level using the seconds you have available. (And remember: if you want to freeze time and think for a bit, you can enter Premonition at any point!).

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/premonition-update-3.jpg[/img] [i]The Timelines show how much time you and your Echoes have in the level[/i]

You’ll see two sets of timelines on screen.  On the left is your main timeline, showing you how much time you have in the level.  Switches you activate are marked as colored lines.  The white triangle indicates when your Echo will enter the level.

On the right hand side of the screen, you’ll see the Echo timeline.  It shows how long your Echo’s lifespan is, and also records which switches it has crossed.

When your Echo’s timeline runs out, it disappears from the level.  When your timeline runs out, the level resets, and you’ll find yourself back in the test chamber.

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/premonition-update-4.jpg[/img][i]Premonition lets you to see the game from new angles[/i]

[h1]Try it out for yourself[/h1]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/611060/ECHOPLEX/]Please give the new update a try[/url] and let us know what you think. We’ve also redesigned some of the levels for better flow and puzzle work - so playing the game will be quite a different experience now.

Your feedback so far has helped us take ECHOPLEX in directions we didn’t expect and we’re really loving it! So thanks again, and we’re looking forward to your feedback on the Premonition update…

notes.title: Timeline Update coming soon...
notes.content:
[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/echoplex-timeline-update-2.jpg[/img]

[h1]The first update to ECHOPLEX Early Access will introduce Echo expiry[/h1]

We’re a few days into the release of ECHOPLEX Early Access, and we’ve gotten some great feedback from the community - thank you!

A criticism we’re hearing often is that many levels can be completed by simply running around blindly.

The reason is that your Echo follows you indefinitely - if you keep moving, you can pretty much stay ahead of him forever. If you keep going in and out of doors and switches randomly, chances are you’ll eventually stumble upon a sequence that completes the puzzle - without really knowing why.

This is obviously not fun, and has no real sense of accomplishment - so we want to fix it!

The Timeline Update seeks to solve the “running blindly” problem by introducing a lifespan for each Echo.

Each Echo’s lifespan will be different, depending on the puzzle. You’ll only have a short amount of time to use that Echo - and if you haven’t figured out the puzzle by the time the Echo expires, you’ll have to restart the level.

[img]http://output.games/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/echo-expiry-timeline.jpg[/img]

We’re introducing a new graphic on the side of the screen (see above) that will show you how much time you have left with each Echo. We’re also experimenting with indicators that will show when an Echo crosses through a switch.

We believe that the Timeline Update will make ECHOPLEX a different (and better) game, and we’re looking forward to hearing what you think.

[i]- Tyron Janse van Vuuren, Game director[/i]
